WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as order_count 
  FROM riskandmargin r 
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault 
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp 
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
    AVG(CAST(order_count AS REAL)) as avg_orders
  FROM order_counts
)
SELECT 
  oc.acctscope,
  oc.order_count,
  CAST(oc.order_count AS REAL) / s.total_orders as fraction_of_total,
  CAST(oc.order_count AS REAL) / s.avg_orders as ratio_to_average
FROM order_counts oc, summary s
ORDER BY oc.acctscope
